description: Fixture offers. Timestamps are authored relative to authoredAt; the seed shifts every offer timestamp by (now - authoredAt) so freshness rules behave the same on any day. seasonalEligibility holds occurrence IDs (<holidayId>.US.<year>). A price is displayed only when priceSource is not none and priceObservedAt is within 24 hours.

offers.notes: Second offer for the same product; ranking tie-breaks between programs.
Same product at an approved program: tracking beats plain for the same product.
Paused: out of stock at verification.
Price shown through the merchant-served link.
Active but last verified 10 days before authoring: excluded by the freshness limit.
Draft: curated but not yet verified.
